The 'fusion' is likely the natural transition between the red nasal ridge and the yellow beard/skin. The Animal Pose Auditor showed HIGH risk (71% low confidence keypoints), but this is largely due to the domain shift (Mandrill vs. generic monkey training data) and occlusion by the ruff.
